blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Written from Muse's verified Tsawwassen East research (sources read 2026-11-01) and the City of Delta's development page, which I read myself. Items marked unconfirmed could not be checked against an official page.
A board name, not a City of Delta neighbourhood

Tsawwassen East is the name the MLS® board uses for the Boundary Bay side of Tsawwassen, east of 56 Street. It is not an official City of Delta neighbourhood, and the City publishes no boundary for it. That matters when you read a Delta report or a plan, because the City talks about Tsawwassen as a whole and uses its own planning names.

Next to it, Tsawwassen Central sits to the west, Boundary Bay and Point Roberts, in the United States, lie to the south, and Ladner is to the north. Beach Grove, the waterfront pocket on Boundary Bay, is the part of the east side most people mean when they say beachfront. Search names that point to the same ground include Boundary Bay and South Delta.
The Boundary Bay shore

Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach are at 570 Boundary Bay Road. Metro Vancouver, which runs the park, lists the Dyke Trail, the Savannah and Raptor trails and Cammidge House there. For most east-side buyers the beach and the dyke are the reason to be here, and they are also the reason to read the shoreline rules below before you fall for a house.
Shoreline and flood rules, one at a time

These rules come from three places: the City's own development page, Delta's Official Community Plan and its Zoning Bylaw. They are easy to confuse, so each gets its own row. The City says exact flood figures for a lot are on DeltaMap or from its Community Planning and Development department, so treat the table as a map of what to ask, not a substitute for the lot check.

blocks.text: The SD3 figures are the ones to double check before you rely on them. If you are buying on the water, ask the City which of these rules apply to the exact parcel, and ask your insurer for a quote before you remove subjects.
Who looks after the dike, and who owns the foreshore

The City of Delta is the diking authority. It operates and maintains more than 63 kilometres of flood protection works, 31 drainage pump stations and about 538 kilometres of drainage works across the municipality, and the east side of Tsawwassen faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike.

The foreshore is a different story. The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore, so a dock or private moorage is not part of the land you buy. It sits on a lease or licence through FrontCounter BC, or under a General Permission or a Specific Permission. Ask the seller what tenure, if any, a dock has, and do not assume it transfers with the house. Delta also says foreshore and water access fall under federal, provincial or Port of Vancouver authority depending on the area.
Zoning on the east side, and what changed in 2024

The waterfront lots in Beach Grove are in zone RD2, which Delta's zoning bylaw describes as duplex and single detached residential and says is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove. Zoning is set parcel by parcel on the City's maps, so a neighbour's zone does not tell you yours, and it is the zone, not the street, that decides whether a duplex or a subdivision is even possible.

Delta's current Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400, replaced the earlier plan and folded the old area plans into one Land Use Plan. The Tsawwassen Area Plan used to be Schedule D.1 of the previous plan, Bylaw No. 3950. Older City reports on a property can still say Single Family Residential, a designation the 2024 plan no longer uses, so a staff report that predates 2024 will not describe today's rules.

Before an offer, ask the City for four things on the exact parcel: its zone, its land use designation under the 2024 plan, the flood elevation shown on DeltaMap, and any covenant registered on the title. A title search shows the covenant, and the City shows the rest, so one request to each covers it.
Five questions to settle before you write an offer on the water
Does the title carry a covenant that sets a minimum elevation for living space, and does the house meet it? Delta says the figure is on DeltaMap.
Is the parcel inside the SD3 foreshore permit area, and if so what did the last permit for work on the lot require?
Is there a seawall, who designed it, and is it on the lot or on the dike? Work near the dike needs the Inspector of Dikes to sign off in writing.
If there is a dock or a mooring, what tenure covers it, and will it carry over to you? Ask for the lease, licence or permission in writing.
What will an insurer quote for flood and water damage on this exact address? Get the answer while subjects are still on.
Condo buildings and new homes on the east side

Two strata buildings are named in the directories we read. Royal Oaks at 1100 56 Street has 109 units (strata plan LMS515), just north of the town centre. Heron Cove at 1706 56 Street has 101 units (strata plan LMS2509) and is in Beach Grove. Those details come from a strata-building directory, not from the City, so confirm them in the strata documents.

The Southlands lands at Market Avenue are the large new-development site here. The developer, Century Group, lists 101 – 6388 Market Avenue as its address, and the City of Delta files the lands under Southlands Properties of Century Industries Ltd., file LU006390.

Streets, schools and getting around Tsawwassen East

items.t: The east side's landmarks are Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach, 570 Boundary Bay Rd (Metro Vancouver) — Dyke Trail, Savannah and Raptor trails, Cammidge House — and Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Ave, on the south side.
Beach Grove, the waterfront pocket inside the east side, is bordered by 19th Avenue, 56th Street, 12th Avenue and the banks of Boundary Bay (neighbourhood description, secondary source).

Local roads are Boundary Bay Road, 12 Avenue and 56 Street; Highway 17 is reached via 56 Street or 52 Street, then Highway 17A and Highway 99 via the George Massey Tunnel. Route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: on and just off 56 Street at the Beach Grove edge — Royal Oaks at the north end by the town centre, then Heron Cove, Windgrove and Tsawwassen Mews strung along the 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor. The Boundary Bay waterfront streets themselves are detached and duplex houses, including the RD2 zone the bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove.

Schools for the sample address 570 Boundary Bay Rd, from the SD37 School Locator: South Park Elementary (K–7), 735 Gilchrist Dr., and South Delta Secondary (8–12), 750 53 St; catchments are address-based.

Shopping and services sit back in the centre: Thrifty Foods on the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall site (1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue, 1236 55 Street), Tsawwassen Library at 1321A 56 St and South Delta Recreation Centre at 1720 56 St.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Tsawwassen East

items.t: Age bylaws: only a 55+ residency bylaw is lawful (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1, 123.2); lower age bylaws have been invalid since Nov 24, 2022, and the bylaw binds residents, not owners. No building here has a verified 55+ bylaw — UNCONFIRMED per building.

Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 — the east side's local overlay: for the Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands, OCP Bylaw No. 8400 provides that no building be located with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, that the minimum land surface elevation around construction be 2.3 metres GSC datum, and that no building be constructed within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. Whether a given corridor building lot falls inside SD3 needs a DeltaMap check for that lot.

Dike and flood system: the east side faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure.

Waterfront setback in the zoning bylaw: Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 6.2.3, sets a waterfront setback for lots fronting on Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue, under which a seawall may encroach into the minimum front setback; the bylaw states no Beach Grove flood construction level.

Foreshore tenure: the Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore; tenure is by lease or licence only via FrontCounter BC, and private moorage is held under General Permission or Specific Permission — relevant to any "private dock" claim on the shore, not to the corridor condos.

Delta zoning and plan generally: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, parcel by parcel; the OCP is the consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024) — no lettered schedules, no Tsawwassen area-plan schedule (the old plan was Schedule D.1 under Bylaw No. 3950); farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)."

PTT exemptions: first-time buyers — exempt on the first $500,000 at fair market value $835,000 or less (Apr 1, 2024), partial to $860,000, 0.5 ha or smaller, principal residence; newly built home exemption — full threshold $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000, including a never-occupied unit in a new condo building.

GST on new construction only: FTHB GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, royal assent Mar 13, 2026) with the new housing rebate — 100% of GST to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; new housing rebate alone 36%, maximum $6,300, phasing out $350,000–$450,000.
Strata disputes: can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

blocks.text: Good to know about Tsawwassen East

items.t: The 2.9 m number is the one to remember on this shore: SD3 sets the habitable floor level at 2.9 metres GSC datum with a 2.3 m minimum land elevation around construction and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area — any renovation or rebuild conversation on a foreshore lot starts there.

A seawall has its own rule here: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 6.2.3, lets a seawall encroach into the minimum front setback on Boundary Bay lots along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue — and the same passage states the bylaw sets no Beach Grove flood construction level, so the FCL question goes to the permit area and the City, not the zoning text.

The dike trail is the amenity, and it is a working dike: Boundary Bay Regional Park's Dyke Trail runs on the Boundary Bay dike system the City maintains as flood protection — recreation on top of infrastructure, which is why foreshore work is permitted, not casual.
Health care: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd in Ladner, is the nearest hospital; Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

Ferry times are published; road times are not: BC Ferries publishes 1 hour 35 minutes Tsawwassen–Swartz Bay and 2 hours Tsawwassen–Duke Point; road commute times from Beach Grove to Vancouver, Surrey Central or the border are UNVERIFIED — no official source read states them.

This is the sub-area's verified fee-simple townhouse-form stock: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees.
Streets, schools and getting around Tsawwassen East

items.t: Where the townhouse stock actually sits: in two places, neither of them on the waterfront streets. The older apartment-condo corridor runs along 56 Street / 16 Avenue at the Beach Grove edge, and the townhouse stock is the new Southlands master-planned community at the south end — Market Avenue and Boundary Bay Road, around the Market District — where Century Group is building townhomes, rowhomes and bare-land strata cottages in named collections.
The Boundary Bay waterfront streets themselves are detached and duplex houses, including the RD2 zone the bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove (4,000 m² subdivision minimum).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Tsawwassen East

items.t: Strata townhomes (The Granary): the Form B is the core document: Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B: Information Certificate states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance net of approved expenditures, and a summary of the strata's insurance, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; the strata must provide it within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. On a presale, the developer's disclosure statement comes first (REDMA, below) and the Form B regime applies on resale.

Fee-simple rowhomes (High Street): plainly no strata: A non-strata freehold rowhouse has no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees, no CRF and no strata bylaws. Diligence is title, zoning, the City permit record and any registered covenants or building scheme on title — a buyer who asks for "the strata documents" on a High Street home is asking for documents that do not exist.

Depreciation reports (strata collections): since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, not deferrable by vote, with 30-year projections and three CRF funding models; a strata established on or after July 1, 2024 must obtain its first report within the new-strata timeline — the position a brand-new Southlands strata starts in.
CRF minimum (strata collections): since Nov 1, 2023, a strata corporation must contribute at least 10% of its annual operating budget to the contingency reserve fund.

Rental-restriction bylaws are void (strata collections): as of Nov 24, 2022, no BC strata may have a residential rental-restriction bylaw — any "rentals not allowed" wording in an older Southlands or corridor document is invalid for long-term rentals. Short-term rentals can still be banned or limited by bylaw. Fee-simple homes have no strata bylaw layer at all, though municipal short-term-rental rules still apply city-wide.

Age bylaws (strata collections): only a 55+ residency bylaw is lawful (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1, 123.2); lower age bylaws have been invalid since Nov 24, 2022, with Regulation 7.01 exemptions (expanded May 1, 2023) for a younger spouse/partner, live-in caregivers, legacy residents and defined child cases. No 55+ bylaw is verified for any Southlands collection — UNCONFIRMED per collection.

Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 — the east side's overlay: for the Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands, the OCP provides that no building be located with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, that the minimum land surface elevation around construction be 2.3 metres GSC datum, and that no building be constructed within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. SD3 names the Southlands expressly — a Southlands townhouse buyer should confirm how it was applied to their collection. Whether a given lot falls inside SD3 needs a DeltaMap check for that lot.

ALR edges (Southlands farms): Southlands sits beside working farm land. An ALR residence cannot be stratified (Agricultural Land Commission Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)) — the legal reason farm-adjacent housing product is structured as it is. Farm-status thresholds run in three tiers — $2,500 in farm sales on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the land value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha — a flat "$2,500+" statement is an error.

Presales (REDMA) — directly live here: a presale buyer must receive the developer's disclosure statement (REDMA s. 18) and has a 7-day statutory rescission period from the later of signing the purchase agreement or acknowledging receipt of that statement (REDMA s. 21); deposits are held in trust. Assignment terms are whatever the purchase contract and disclosure statement say — no assignment term for any Southlands collection was verified: UNCONFIRMED per collection.

GST on new construction — the Southlands question: new townhomes carry GST. FTHB GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA News No. 122) — 100% of GST to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; the New Housing Rebate alone is 36%, maximum $6,300, phasing out $350,000–$450,000.

PTT and exemptions: first-time buyers — exempt on the first $500,000 at fair market value $835,000 or less (Apr 1, 2024), partial to $860,000, principal residence; newly built home exemption — full threshold $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000, which can apply to a never-occupied new townhouse.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Tsawwassen East
Southlands

items.t: Southlands Tsawwassen (Century Group) — Market Avenue / Boundary Bay Road: Southlands as a whole is a 537-acre master-planned community planned for about 950 homes, with development approval in 2013 and sales beginning in 2020; by mid-October reporting about 120 homes had closed and about 100 were under construction — community totals across ALL housing forms, never quote them as lot counts.

The land-tenure mix IS the Southlands fact: housing ranges across "single-family homes, bare-land strata single-family homes, non-strata row homes, traditional townhomes and condos," with each pocket of 10–25 homes potentially under a different ownership structure — no tenure is ever assumed from the Southlands name alone; every collection below carries its own tenure line.

High Street Rowhomes — Southlands Drive and Boundary Bay Road. FEE-SIMPLE (non-strata freehold): 10 homes, 3 storeys, by Century Group; the project source states expressly the rowhomes are "non-strata, freehold" with no strata fees. As land form: fee-simple lots with a house on each — no strata corporation, no Form B.

Beachcomber Cottages — Southlands. BARE-LAND STRATA — its own form: Detached cottages (1,320–1,410 sq ft) around a shared courtyard, described by the presale source as bare-land strata homes. Plainly: a bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure — the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the cottage on it, and Form B, strata fees for common property, and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is NOT a fee-simple lot and NOT a townhouse. Phase/unit count: UNCONFIRMED in the sources read.

The Granary (townhome portion) — Market District, Red Barn Boulevard and Market Avenue. STRATA: 19 walk-up townhomes (plus 16 garden flats, apartment-form, counted in condos) — built housing on Southlands land, cross-referenced as a land phase only; its strata fee figure in the presale source is developer-estimated and is not a land fact. Heirloom Townhomes — Southlands. Tenure UNCONFIRMED. A group of 33 townhouses and duplexes recorded as sold out in a community profile — the source mixes forms and states no tenure split, so no land tenure is asserted for it here. Centennial Green — Southlands. UNCONFIRMED / QUEUE. Named as "family-friendly townhomes with a green courtyard," move-in ready; unit count, civic address and tenure UNCONFIRMED — carried as a named queue item only.

Other Southlands cottage collections: (e.g. Harrow Estate Cottages, described as freehold homes, and the Courtyard Cottages) are detached single-family form; tenure must be read collection by collection — UNCONFIRMED beyond the sources cited — and none is presented here as vacant lots for sale.

Farm ground inside the plan: the community reporting describes 275 acres of publicly owned Southlands Farm plus a 50-acre community farm inside the 537-acre community — working agriculture is part of the plan, not leftover development land, and is not lot inventory.

: no Southlands phase is documented in the sources read as selling vacant serviced LOTS to individual builders — phases sell built homes (presale homes under REDMA). Presale lots are therefore counted at zero verified, separately from the built phases above, never mixed with them.

blocks.text: Outside Southlands

items.t: Beach Grove waterfront lots — fee-simple, large-lot form: 1728 Beach Grove Road is confirmed zoned RD2 (Duplex/Single Detached Residential 2); RD2 carries a 4,000 m² minimum lot size for subdivision, a zone the bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove. RD2/RD3 and RS1–RS3 sit at 4,000 m² in the ladder, so east-side lots — especially on the waterfront — are much larger than town-centre minimums; urban zones RS4 (610 m²) through RS7 (335 m²) also exist in the ladder and zoning is parcel by parcel.

ALR vs non-ALR split: no area-wide split is published in the research and none is stated. Southlands sits beside working farm land and its farm acres are planned farm (above); any individual parcel's ALR status is checked on the ALC maps by PID or civic address.

Serviced vs unserviced ground: no parcel-level servicing statement for East lots is documented in the research — UNCONFIRMED per parcel. Confirm City connections for a Southlands or Beach Grove parcel; for any unserviced parcel, GWELLS plus Fraser Health's onsite-sewerage position.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Tsawwassen East

items.t: Landmarks are Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach, 570 Boundary Bay Rd (Metro Vancouver) — Dyke Trail, Savannah and Raptor trails, Cammidge House — and Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Ave, on the south side. Local roads are Boundary Bay Road, 12 Avenue and 56 Street; Highway 17 is reached via 56 Street or 52 Street, then Highway 17A and Highway 99 via the George Massey Tunnel. Route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.

Where land actually sits, in two systems: (a) the large fee-simple waterfront/detached lots of Beach Grove and the Boundary Bay shore, and (b) the Southlands master-planned lands at the south end — Market Avenue and Boundary Bay Road — where a former farm-designated parcel is being built out in named phases. The 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor between them is built apartment-condo stock, not land.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Tsawwassen East

items.t: Waterfront setback: Zoning Bylaw s. 6.2.3 sets a waterfront setback for lots fronting Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue, under which a seawall may encroach into the minimum front setback; the bylaw states no Beach Grove flood construction level — the FCL question goes to the permit area and the City, not the zoning text.

Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands) — the east side's overlay, and it names Southlands expressly: no building with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres GSC datum; minimum land surface elevation around construction 2.3 metres GSC datum; no building within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. Whether a given lot falls inside SD3 needs a DeltaMap check for that lot.

Dyke / flood frame: the east side faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority (over 63 km of flood protection, 31 pump stations, ~538 km of drainage). Foreshore tenure: the Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore; tenure is by lease or licence only via FrontCounter BC, and private moorage is held under General Permission or Specific Permission — a "private dock" is not land the seller owns.

ALR rules (farm-edge parcels): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)) — the legal reason farm-adjacent product is structured as it is; subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval. ALC caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class — three-tier, in full: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an ERROR.

Bare-land strata block (applies to Beachcomber Cottages lots and any strata Southlands phase): Form B (SPA s. 59) discloses monthly fees, amounts owed, approved levies still payable, CRF balance and insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for 5+ lots since July 1, 2024, non-deferrable; a strata established on/after July 1, 2024 follows the new-strata first-report timeline. CRF minimum 10% since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted). Only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2; May 1, 2023 exemptions). Fee-simple contrast: High Street homes carry none of this — no strata, no Form B, no fees.

Presales (REDMA) — live in Southlands: a presale buyer must receive the developer's disclosure statement (REDMA s. 18) and has a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing or acknowledging it (s. 21); deposits are held in trust. Assignment terms are contract-specific — none verified per collection: UNCONFIRMED.

GST — land and new homes, CRA level only: CRA GI-003: most individual personal-use vacant-land sales are exempt; business-use, in-the-course-of-business and more-than-two-part subdivision sales can be taxable — developer/newly-subdivided lots generally TAXABLE. On a new Southlands HOME, GST applies with the FTHB rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122; 100% to $1M, max $50,000, phasing to $1.5M, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031) — the rebate applies to new HOUSING, not bare land itself — and the New Housing Rebate (36%, max $6,300, $350,000–$450,000) underneath it. HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000 per year; CMHC 0.6%–4.5%.

Speculation/vacancy + prohibition — Delta only: SVT taxable areas include the City of Delta; reserve/treaty/self-governing lands are excluded. Vancouver Empty Homes Tax (3%) is Vancouver ONLY. SVT payable on a specific vacant parcel and any federal prohibition position per buyer: UNCONFIRMED in this research.

items.t: A seawall has its own rule here: s. 6.2.3 lets a seawall encroach into the minimum front setback on Boundary Bay lots along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue — and the same passage states the bylaw sets no Beach Grove flood construction level.

The Pillars is two products at two addresses. 1700 56 Street is the townhouse component (Beach Grove townhomes); 1702 is the apartment component (condos only). A land or housing search that treats "The Pillars" as one tenure will misprice both.

faq.q: Is Tsawwassen East an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. It is the MLS® board's name for the Boundary Bay side of Tsawwassen. The City does not publish a boundary for it, and Delta plans Tsawwassen as a whole under its 2024 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400.

faq.q: Who maintains the Boundary Bay dike?
faq.a: The City of Delta is the diking authority. Changes to a dike or the ground beside it need written approval from the Inspector of Dikes.

faq.q: Can I build a dock on a Boundary Bay waterfront lot?
faq.a: Not as part of the land. The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore, and private moorage needs a lease or licence through FrontCounter BC or a General or Specific Permission. Federal and Port of Vancouver rules can also apply, depending on the area.

faq.q: What zone are Beach Grove waterfront lots in?
faq.a: Delta's zoning bylaw describes zone RD2, duplex and single detached residential, as the zone for waterfront lots in Beach Grove. Zoning is set parcel by parcel, so check the City's zoning map for the exact lot.

faq.q: What is the TransLink route for Boundary Bay?
faq.a: Route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips along 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street, then through South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.

faq.q: Is Tsawwassen East an official City of Delta neighbourhood?
faq.a: No. It is a Paragon sub-area name for the Boundary Bay side of Tsawwassen, planned under the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), and no official boundary exists for the name.

faq.q: What beach and trails are on the east side?
faq.a: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach (Metro Vancouver) are on Boundary Bay Road, with the Dyke Trail and the Savannah and Raptor trails, and Cammidge House in the park.

faq.q: Which schools serve the east side?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD37. For the sample address 570 Boundary Bay Rd, the locator result is South Park Elementary (K–7) and South Delta Secondary (8–12), with no middle-school category.

faq.q: Are any of these buildings on the water?
faq.a: No — the verified Beach Grove condo buildings (Royal Oaks, Heron Cove, Windgrove, Tsawwassen Mews) sit on the 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor; the Boundary Bay waterfront stock is detached and duplex housing, including RD2 lots the bylaw describes as waterfront lots in Beach Grove.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Heron Cove unit if the directory says rentals are not allowed?
faq.a: Long-term, yes — every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw became invalid on Nov 24, 2022, whatever older records say. Short-term rentals are different: a strata can still ban or limit them by bylaw, so read the current registered bylaws.

Directory records: Royal Oaks — pets allowed with restrictions; Heron Cove — pets allowed with restrictions; Windgrove — pets allowed with restrictions in the directory, but a unit listing calls the building pet-friendly with no pet-size restriction. The conflict means the answer for a specific building is UNCONFIRMED until the registered bylaws are read; Tsawwassen Mews' pet rule is UNCONFIRMED outright.

faq.q: Is flood risk priced into these buildings the way it is on the waterfront?
faq.a: The hazard layer is real but graded: SD3's floor-level (2.9 m GSC datum), land-elevation (2.3 m) and 7.5 m tidal-setback rules are written for the Boundary Bay foreshore and the Southlands, and the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike. Whether a specific corridor lot is inside SD3 is a DeltaMap check — do it lot by lot rather than assuming either way.

faq.q: How do I compare strata fees between a 1977 building and a 2005 building?
faq.a: Off the Form B, not the listing: the certificate states the lot's monthly fees, amounts owing, approved levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the budget and the latest depreciation report attached — and since July 1, 2024 that report must be refreshed every five years for stratas of five or more lots, which is what makes an older building's fee comparable at all.

faq.q: Are any east-side townhouses actually on the water?
faq.a: No. The verified townhouse collections are all inside Southlands, inland of the dike around the Market District; the Boundary Bay waterfront stock is detached and duplex housing, including RD2 lots the bylaw describes as waterfront lots in Beach Grove.

faq.q: What is the difference between a Granary townhome and a High Street rowhome if both are "townhomes" in Southlands?
faq.a: Tenure. The Granary is strata product (the presale source publishes an estimated strata fee), so it carries strata fees, bylaws, a Form B on resale and a depreciation report. The High Street Rowhomes are expressly non-strata freehold — no strata fees and no strata documents at all. Same community name, opposite diligence packages.

faq.q: Is a Beachcomber Cottage a townhouse?
faq.a: A buyer comparing it to a Granary townhome is comparing two different strata forms with different common-property obligations.
